name: api-5xx-errors
title: API is repeatedly returning HTTP 5xx responses
description: The API has returned at least one HTTP 5xx response during each of the last five minutes.
investigation_steps: Review the matching logs to identify the failing endpoints, status codes and errors.
Check the health of the API ECS service and its running tasks.
Check for recent deployments, database problems or failed dependencies.

query: fields @timestamp, status, request_method, request_uri, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, aws_request_id, @message, @logStream
